thesis: Visa는 v3.3에서 Compounder 적격이며 core score 78.39, ex-valuation 83.31, deterministic fit 83.1이다. 해자·고객가치·재투자·재무생존력은 강하고 Hard Veto 9개는 모두 cleared다. 다만 현재가 $368.29는 Base $328.59보다 약 12% 높고 EV 50.5·AS 61로 기대차가 크지 않으며, 도메인 전반의 downside skew가 severe로 분류됐다. IC는 NORMAL로 확대하지 않고 STARTER 1–2%만 승인하며 macro pacing 0.5로 분할 집행한다.

evidence.claim: Core score is 78.39, ex-valuation score is 83.31, coverage is 100%, and Compounder is the sole reachable eligible archetype with deterministic fit 83.1.
All nine Hard Vetoes are CLEARED after domain-owner and Red Team review.
Locked valuation is Bear $133.34, Base $328.59 and Bull $467.20 versus frozen price $368.29; price/Base is 1.1208x.
Moat Trajectory 88.5, Reinvestment/FCF 83.5, Management 82.0 and Financial Survival 84.0 clear Compounder thresholds; Customer/Product is 90.0 and Structural Leadership 88.75.
Expectation/Valuation is 50.5 and Asymmetry is 61.0; dispersion mean downside skew is 12.0 and reduces the deployment band by two steps, leaving pre-IC deployment at 0–2%.
The macro overlay has no fundamental score effect but sets purchase pacing to 0.5 because the binding global overlay is high geopolitical energy/shipping stress.

counterevidence: The frozen price is above locked Base value and the five-year valuation percentile is 69%, so the entry lacks a conventional margin of safety.
Asymmetry is only 61 and the Bear value is far below market price, so valuation de-rating can produce substantial mark-to-market downside without business failure.
Regulatory routing/interchange changes and account-to-account alternatives can pressure monetization even if Visa remains a dominant network.
The macro overlay is restrictive and Visa's frozen geo_exposure is sparse, so company-specific transmission of current geopolitical shocks is not fully mapped.
unknowns: Long-run regulation of interchange, routing and effective take rates.
Sustainable growth and unit economics of Visa Direct and value-added services.
Long-run client-incentive intensity and its effect on incremental margins.
Company-level geographic exposure needed to map current geopolitical transmission more precisely.
falsifiers: Compounder eligibility fails if Moat Trajectory or Reinvestment/FCF falls below 76, Management or Financial Survival below 72, or incremental ROIC/reinvestment runway falls below the configured thresholds.
Do not increase the position if owner FCF/share persistently undershoots the locked Base path or client incentives rise faster than economic value creation.
If price/Base rises above 1.2 without a higher refrozen intrinsic value, the Compounder price gate fails.

key_kpis.name: Owner FCF/share vs Base path
key_kpis.threshold: stay on or above the locked Base path

key_kpis.name: Payments volume / processed transactions / VAS growth
key_kpis.threshold: sustain high-single to low-double-digit core growth with VAS outgrowth

key_kpis.name: Client incentives and regulatory take-rate pressure
key_kpis.threshold: no structural compression sufficient to break moat/FCF thresholds

next_checks: FY2026 10-K: refresh owner FCF/share, incentives, buybacks, debt and regulatory disclosures.
Re-run locked valuation after the next full-year filing and update price/Base.
Map Visa geographic revenue/regulatory exposure so the macro-geopolitical transmission layer is company-specific.

plain_language.business: Visa는 카드 대출을 직접 해주는 회사가 아니라, 은행·가맹점·소비자를 연결해 결제를 승인·처리하는 글로벌 결제 네트워크다. 결제량이 늘고 부가서비스 사용이 확대될수록 높은 현금흐름을 만들 수 있는 구조다.
plain_language.opportunity: 핵심 카드 네트워크의 규모와 전환비용이 강하고, Visa Direct·상업결제·부가가치 서비스가 추가 성장축이다. 하네스에서는 해자, 고객가치, 재투자 능력과 재무안정성이 모두 컴파운더 기준을 통과했다.
plain_language.risk: 가장 큰 위험은 회사의 생존이 아니라 가격과 규제다. 현재 주가는 Base 내재가치보다 높고, 규제·대체 결제망·고객 인센티브가 장기 수익성을 낮추면 주가가 크게 재평가될 수 있다.
plain_language.decision_reason: 중대한 탈락 사유는 모두 해소됐지만 현재 가격의 기대차와 상승·하락 비대칭성이 충분히 크지 않다. 따라서 정상 비중으로 바로 가지 않고 1~2% Starter만 허용하며, 현재 거시환경에서는 그 매수도 평소의 절반 속도로 나눈다.
